english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for anticipating that an event will happen.
Use 預計 as the all-purpose verb for expecting a future event in advance, without emphasizing excitement.
Use this as the all-purpose everyday verb for predicting or expecting a future situation or event.
Use this when the prediction is an estimate or expectation about what is likely to happen.

examples.english: I expect it will rain tomorrow.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jyu6 gai3 ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5
ngo5 jyu6 gai3 ting1 jat6 wui5 sak1 ce1

examples.english: I foresee that it will rain tomorrow.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jyu6 gai3 ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5

examples.english: We predict that we will arrive before three in the afternoon.
examples.traditional: 我哋預計下午三點前到。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jyu6 gai3 haa6 ng5 saam1 dim2 cin4 dou3
